title: Craftable Red Sand
description: Adds the ability to craft red sand and its variants.
body:
# Craftable Red Sand


**Features**

This data pack adds the ability to craft red sand and sandstone.

**Adds recipes for:**

- Red Sand
- Red Sandstone
- Smooth Red Sandstone
- Cut Red Sandstone
- Chiselled Red Sandstone

EACH RECIPE GIVES 4 OF EACH BLOCK IN RETURN

**Installation**

Download the datapack
Move the datapack to **.minecraft/saves/world/datapacks**

Reload the world or do /reload


**Uninstalling**

Simply remove the datapack from **.minecraft/saves/world/datapacks**

**_NOTE_**: Works in 1.21.9-1.21.10; may work in later or earlier versions, however it has not been tested.
